Hamish Stewart (born 30 July 1999) is a Scottish tennis player. He has a career high singles world ranking of No. 478 achieved on 18 March 2024.
Early life
He is from Strathblane in Scotland, and played junior tennis at Wimbledon when he was a teenager.
Career
He was the Tennis Scotland Open Tour Finals men's champion in 2023, before playing a full season on the professional tour in 2024.
In June 2025, he was awarded a wildcard into gentleman's singles qualifying event at the 2025 Wimbledon Championships, and in the first round saved a match point before he was awarded a victory after his opponent Valentin Vacherot retired with injury. In the second round he defeated Frenchman Luca Van Assche in three sets  before playing Leandro Riedi.
He was a semi-finalist on the Challenger Tour in Nottingham in July 2025, where he faced compatriot Kyle Edmund in the semi-finals.
Personal life
He played college tennis in the United States completing an undergraduate degree at Tulane University and completing a post-graduate course at the University of Georgia in 2022.
